checked_claims.note: H^{16}(\overline{M}_{6,6};Q)≅Q(-8)^{⊕N} is the load-bearing step. The writeup asserts a general low-degree diagonal lemma and then a one-paragraph arc-resolution/chain-homotopy calculation; neither constructs the normalized complex, nor controls Gysin/Künneth shifts, graph-automorphism (co)invariants, spectral-sequence differentials, or higher-genus primitive summands. Exhaustiveness of the listed primitive entries is not proved.

The proper-pair exact sequence and weight bound give a genuine injection Gr_{16}^W H_c^{16}(M_{6,6};Q)↪H^{16}(\overline{M}_{6,6};Q) for Q-MHS reasons. The upgrade from that injection to a pure Tate conclusion depends entirely on C1, which fails as a proof, so the Tate claim for Gr_{16} remains undischarged.

Formal MHS dual of Gr_{16}^W H_c^{16} is W_{-16}H_{16}^{BM}, and dual of Q(-8) is Q(8). The identification is correct as bookkeeping, but the pure-Tate conclusion inherits the unresolved status of C2/C1.

For smooth DM stack X of dimension 21 over Q, Poincaré duality H_{16}^{BM}(X;Q)≅H^{26}(X;Q)(21) and the matching of weight pieces W_{-16}BM≅W_{26} ordinary twisted by (21) are standard; Q(-13)(21)=Q(8). This confirms only the equivalence of the two formulations, not purity.

The stated low-degree diagonal lemma, at equality 2r=2g+n-2, claims only that ker(restriction to the boundary) is Tate, then silently upgrades for (6,6,r=8) to the whole group H^{16}. That upgrade is exactly the incomplete boundary/arc calculation and is not discharged.

Stable-graph strata contribute Aut(Γ)-invariants (or coinvariants, depending on normalization) of Künneth products of vertex cohomologies. The argument never treats graph automorphisms; non-Tate summands can appear or be projected out only after this step.

The claim that after arc contraction every non-diagonal degree-≤16 entry is elliptic is a major structural assertion. Genus-≥2 primitive/motive contributions (and their Gysin-shifted placements) are excluded by slogan rather than by a complete filtration or spectral-sequence analysis.

finding_candidates.evidence: Standard MHS strictness applied in ATT-0027 §2; independent of the failed diagonal argument.
finding_candidates.statement: For X=M_{g,n} and \overline{X}=\overline{M}_{g,n} with D=\overline{X}\setminus X proper, the pair sequence and weight bounds yield Gr_k^W H_c^k(X;Q)↪H^k(\overline{X};Q) whenever H^{k-1}(D;Q) has weights ≤k-1 (as for proper D). Thus purity of the top graded piece of compactly supported cohomology in degree k reduces to purity of a subobject of H^k(\overline{X}).

finding_candidates.evidence: Internal scope mismatch in ATT-0027 §1 between the stated limiting lemma and the claimed whole-group conclusion for (6,6,r=8).
finding_candidates.statement: A low-degree diagonal statement that, at 2r=2g+n-2, only the kernel of restriction H^{2r}(\overline{M}_{g,n})→H^{2r}(D) is Tate does not by itself make the whole group H^{2r}(\overline{M}_{g,n}) Tate; boundary-supported classes and the full stratified contribution must still be controlled.

No complete unconditional proof that H^{16}(\overline{M}_{6,6};Q) is a direct sum of Q(-8) is supplied by ATT-0027; graph-complex/arc-contraction slogans without Aut-invariants, Gysin shifts, differentials, and higher-genus primitives do not discharge this.

finding_candidates.evidence: ATT-0027 §§2–3 bookkeeping; confirms formulation only, not purity of the group.
finding_candidates.statement: For (g,n)=(6,6), dim=21, the equivalences W_{-16}H_{16}^{BM}≅(Gr_{16}^W H_c^{16})^∨ and W_{-16}H_{16}^{BM}≅W_{26}H^{26}(21), with Q(-8)^∨≅Q(8) and Q(-13)(21)≅Q(8), match the campaign target dictionary over Q.

strongest_attack: The pure-Tate claim for H^{16}(\overline{M}_{6,6};Q) is load-bearing and undischarged: the arc-resolution chain homotopy, exhaustiveness of primitive entries, Gysin/Künneth degree-and-Tate bookkeeping, graph-automorphism (co)invariants, and exclusion of higher-genus non-Tate summands are all asserted without a complete complex or spectral-sequence control. The proper-pair injection Gr_{16}^W H_c^{16}↪H^{16}(\overline{M}) is fine, so any non-Tate class in H^{16}(\overline{M}_{6,6}) (or any non-Tate class surviving that injection) would immediately leave a non-Tate summand in the exact target; the writeup never rules this out rigorously. Equality-case diagonal lemma scope only gives a boundary kernel, not the whole group, until that incomplete calculation is finished.
theorem_statement: The exact group W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q), equivalently W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)(21), is a direct sum of Q(8); a disproof must exhibit a surviving non-Tate summand in this exact group.
